title: حمام تاریخی
subtitle: تور مجازی ۳۶۰ درجه
//rawDir: Where the source photographs live. Absolute, or relative to the project root. Left outside the repo on purpose — these are hundreds of megabytes and usually sit in cloud storage.
//mapFromNode: The mini-map stays hidden below this node. The entrance staircase sits at the very edge of the plan, where a dot reads as noise rather than orientation. Set to 1 to always show it.
//blueprint: Optional. The architect's PDF, if the floor plan was generated from one. `npm run floorplan` reads it.
